6334.title: Retire revoked pulse and timer Host Call owners into retained providers
6334.body:
The environmental native worker must eventually return its actual GPIO/timer providers to Root after attributed quiescence so a later separately admitted Play can use them. Current pulse and monotonic-wait Host Call owners expose revocation/inspection but no consuming retirement path. Dropping or cloning provider descriptions is not a lawful custody transfer.

Scope: add a consuming, allocation-free retirement boundary to these two native Host Call owner types, preserving the retained owner on refusal. It returns only the actual provider and its attachment after capability lifecycle is Revoked and in-flight operations are zero. Issued/exhausted possession does not imply retirement. Returned providers carry no capability table, handle, claim, or permission for a new Play. Root must separately admit any subsequent installation and binding.

Acceptance: live possession refuses without losing custody; explicit revocation permits exact provider/attachment recovery once; cancellation drops provider work and retires only after zero in-flight; empty retained slots refuse; wrong-binding revocation cannot enable retirement. Do not claim this alone implements worker rearming, resource generation advancement, a second Play, owner-loss recovery, or recording.


## Independent combined CPU acceptance proof (2026-10-24 UTC)

The [retained combined proof packet](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/6023aa29805ab099e685eb1c3722e6f4907b0238/evidence/6334-combined-retirement) records execution at test source `1d62af38d72b6a7117c30554d7d9af5562278066`, combining delivered pulse source from devdd3cdb41f with timer candidatecc527bec2 and separate generic regression tests. Only test files differ from the clean combined production source. Both strict all-target Clippy checks passed; pulse Host Call tests passed12cases and timer tests passed12cases. Raw commands/logs and exact source correspondence are retained in the packet.

New public-API tests use actual one-operation budgets (and an independently retained one-count timer configuration). Each observes completed1/in-flight0/Exhausted, verifies retirement returnsNotRevoked without moving or changing the retained owner, confirms another request causes no second provider effect, then explicitly revokes and recovers the exact provider/attachment once. Empty-slot refusal and zero allocations/reallocations are checked. Existing tests retain issued/live refusal, wrong-binding revocation refusal and cancellation quiescence before provider recovery.

Pulse PR #6344 is delivered by squashdd3cdb41f after successful exact-head Candidate40043455270; the exact before/after blobs were audited. Timer delivery and applicable successful combined Integration remain to be verified. This local CPU proof does not close the issue or claim physical installation, rearming, resource-generation advancement, another Play, owner-loss recovery or recording. The new test additions remain separately reviewable on `proof/6334-combined-retirement-20261024`; neither implementation PR source was changed by this proof work.

6346.title: Deliver configured zero-result native binding and owned monotonic waits to dev
6346.body:
The native appliance's monotonic-wait owner is held on work/environment-construction but absent from dev. A fresh dev delivery probe at 5b7e5675c fails because selected operation binding lacks both configured entry points: bind_selected_configured_operation and bind_selected_assigned_configured_operation. Dev also assumes one result port; time/tick waits produce no result. Do not weaken configuration checks or introduce a compatibility timer loop.

Deliver the smallest generic selected-operation prerequisites first, with independently retained expected Source configuration for ordinary and assigned binding, exact zero-result shapes, and positive/negative configuration and shape proofs. Preserve existing unconfigured callers, opaque locally issued authority, exact Host/Boot/Plan/Play/resource identity and allocation-free invocation. Then deliver the owned monotonic-wait crate, readiness/assigned transfer and revoked idle retirement with a supported cargo xtask entrance. Keep implementation files bounded and separate generic binding proof from physical device claims.

Held provenance: 0422993e1 (ordinary configured binding), 430f21596 (assigned configuration), b8c4836bb (exact port shapes), 6226cdfe6 through 8d74e6bd9 (owned wait and transfer), 5b0f66a0b (retirement). Adapt their smallest semantic delta to current dev rather than wholesale stale file replacement. Refs #6334, #6328 and #6345. This is prerequisite delivery, not acceptance of rearming, a resident recorder, network join success or the Pi client.

6350.title: Share immutable Resource snapshot records between browser and Linux recorder Hosts
6350.body:
The recorder must eventually use symmetric browser and Linux/Pi stores. Its existing immutable snapshot record codec currently lives inside the browser runtime. Extract only that bounded record preparation/publication/restore implementation into a generic no-std/alloc mechanism, preserving record bytes, storage key derivation, exact reference version/extent, current residence and independent authority checks.

Keep browser public paths as re-exports, retain browser Host Call request correlation and effect execution in place, and move the existing sealed-placement fixture tests to the generic owner without duplicating their implementation. Add a supported cargo xtask check covering generic codec tests, browser operation tests and strict codec lint. Scope excludes a filesystem provider, catalog seed custody, Body admission, Line or complete recorder deployment; those remain subsequent appliance work. Refs #6325 and #6347.

6353.title: Accept identical embedded compositor copies while refusing distinct images
6353.body:
Integration40042897373 at `5b7e5675c98aa3b660d6f43376006e8ab4528c21` fails x86_64 job120719162620 after the normal product journey with `embedded compositor ELF: Ambiguous`. The actual diagnostics artifact12541842685 (ZIP SHA256 `f8c79acd7ac7ae9bf96164f2cdbc0fa5fff89abb29a03767cfbf9790c270bee1`) retains Root ELF `aa3ac2db80b8ef96254afddcd0a7051491a47667af03b5aeda04ed986a068981`. Running the unchanged extractor against those actual bytes reproduces the refusal. It finds two complete 29256-byte compositor images at offsets16538634 and20470131; both have SHA256 `eb6ef0c507baa3d1117ebc70882c81bba72ca213610288ad0d1f5b93d261d483` and are fully byte-identical.

The collector should establish one unique validated image byte sequence, allowing repeated copies of the exact same image. It must continue to refuse distinct valid images rather than selecting the first candidate or using a serial-supplied hash to resolve ambiguity. This is artifact collection, not a production guest execution or authority change.

Acceptance:
- Reproduce and retain the actual failed-run Root/log/artifact identity and exact candidate equality.
- Accept duplicate identical complete images; reject two distinct structurally valid images. Retain malformed entry/symbol/permissions/extent, missing image and loaded-range refusals.
- Keep actual Root/ISO/build/boot and lifecycle/ACK identity joins intact. Update custody wording to unique image bytes, not unique occurrence.
- Pass focused extractor regressions and the supported preflight gate. Preserve the old failure as negative evidence; artifact reprocessing is not a new QEMU execution.
- Deliver through a reviewed PR with required exact-head Candidate and applicable successful Integration before closing. This does not claim physical display, broader service isolation or parent-issue completion.

The integration shepherd will include the bounded collector repair in the existing reviewed omnibus #6339 so the red dev repair does not add another competing implementation PR.
